mechanism: Both agents are nephrotoxic and can cause additive renal damage; tobramycin's aminoglycoside nephrotoxicity is potentiated by ceftazidime's beta-lactam structure, and cephalosporins may inhibit tobramycin renal clearance.
action: Monitor serum creatinine and BUN closely; ensure adequate hydration; consider therapeutic drug monitoring of tobramycin; use lowest effective doses and shortest duration; assess renal function baseline and regularly during therapy.
